IDENT.title: A study on deep reinforcement learning-based crane scheduling model for uncertainty tasks

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: In reinforcement learning, intelligent agents with learning ability have interactive trial and error with their environment; each crane viewed as single intelligent agent.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: In reinforcement learning, intelligent agents with learning ability have interactive trial and error with their environment, allowing the continuous learning and achievement of the objective.

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: views each crane as single intelligent agent and the respective workshop as the environment

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: views each crane as single intelligent agent

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: Intelligent agent consists of neural network structure and reinforcement learning algorithm.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: redesigning the interaction between multiple Q network and the environment on the basis of Deep Q-Learning (DQN) algorithm

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: by applying Python 2.7 language, deep learning framework Pytorch 0.2.0, and reinforcement learning platform OpenAI Gym

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: neural networks are trained using historic data in the speciﬁc situation

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Q-network weights and a replay buffer (1 million) per crane
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: playback memory pool size M = 1 million

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: the status it observes is the status of task information and status of all cranes within the cross-region

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: the status it observes is the status of task information and status of all cranes within the cross-region

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: close to 100% convergence rate after 9 million steps of iterative training

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: which needs to contain all feature information necessary for decision-making

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The sum of respective reward value is the immediate reward of multiple network models.

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: deep reinforcement learning-based crane scheduling model

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: on the basis of Deep Q-Learning (DQN) algorithm

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: the action space is simpliﬁed to 5 instead of 7

E_LEARNING__learning_quality_measured.evidence_quote: the convergence rate is represented by the ratio of completing transportation tasks under the same training step

E_LEARNING__learning_quality_metric.value: proportion of tasks completed vs training steps; training time
E_LEARNING__learning_quality_metric.evidence_quote: the convergence rate is represented by the ratio of completing transportation tasks under the same training step

E_LEARNING__simulation_model_source.evidence_quote: it is normally an abstraction of the actual environment, including the status space, action space, and reward function

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The crane scheduling plan for testing set is created based on the model and the time-space orbit graphics of the cranes are drawn

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: task completion time, times of routes collision, and return distance when routes collide

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: compared with the manual scheduling plan in actual production process (with same 100 items of crane tasks)

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: the tasks cannot be accurately predicted, therefore only reactive crane scheduling method can be generated

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: Testing of the model is carried out based on practical crane scheduling in one steelmaking workshop.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: speciﬁc convolutional neural network needs to be designed for each crane

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Resource (crane) agents learn DQN policies with summed shared reward; no product agents, capability discovery, explicit negotiation or formal model.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: The sum of respective reward value is the immediate reward of multiple network models.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: This study selected a 3 × 30 matrix to symbolize status space.
